ASUS TUF Gaming VG249QE5A 23.8 Inch FHD IPS 146Hz (OC) Gaming Monitor

Step up your gaming experience with the ASUS TUF Gaming VG249QE5A 23.8 Inch FHD gaming monitor, offered by Turbo Computer Egypt. Engineered with a premium Fast IPS panel delivering Full HD 1920x1080 resolution, this monitor features an overclocked 146Hz refresh rate and a 1ms MPRT response time for exceptionally fluid gameplay. Packed with exclusive ASUS gaming technologies like ELMB Sync (Extreme Low Motion Blur Sync) and Adaptive-Sync, it completely eliminates screen tearing and ghosting. Color accuracy is superb with 125% sRGB coverage and Shadow Boost technology to clarify dark map environments. Complete with practical built-in stereo speakers and a sturdy tilt stand, this display is fully covered by a 3-year local agency warranty.
